verdict.rationale: Navan documents a real public API centered on expenses. It retrieves and batch-updates card transactions, manual expenses, repayments, disputes and similar records, and it also covers custom fields, users, accounting/ERP settings, receipts and webhooks under OAuth client credentials. The hosted MCP server is framed mainly around querying and analyzing data. Much of the UI surface has no documented API equivalent, including travel booking and changes, policy and approval workflow configuration, card issuance, and reimbursement issuance. missing for 10: travel booking/modification via API, policy and approval-workflow management via API, card management/issuance writes, reimbursement actions, any stated UI–API parity commitment, independent corroboration.
